recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16153; any generated diagram refresh or later example wording refinement should stay with the FHIR-20510 issue family.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ServiceRequest change request to add structured quantity/amount support for requested services, especially LTSS service plans, with Quantity, Ratio, and Range support and a distinction from scheduling/timing details.
initial_application: Commit b1dc88787aabb8826e7ca5b5661a308df6f57bf0 (GF#15692, GF#16153) added ServiceRequest.quantity[x] to the old ServiceRequest spreadsheet with cardinality 0..1, type Quantity|Ratio|Range, short 'Service amount', and amount-of-service wording. Later source refactors preserved this in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Zulip and OO Confluence records show the work group discussed the need for units that Timing could not represent and approved GF#16153 in a 2018-07-31 block vote. FHIR-20510 later clarified the definition/comment and added a ratio example for the same element; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active ServiceRequest resource already defines ServiceRequest.quantity[x] as a 0..1 Quantity, Ratio, or Range choice with accepted service amount semantics, and changing the element name to amount[x] would contradict both the original application and later approved references to ServiceRequest.quantity[x].

related_jiras.note: Clarified the definition/comment and example for ServiceRequest.quantity[x], preserving the element introduced by FHIR-16153; it was already audited on the combined branch.
